title: Door, Handshake, Nonlocal Relation & Seed Propagation Model
status: archive-generated hybrid/network model spanning psychology, communication and symbolic Potatoverse structure; not a quantum-nonlocality theory
abstract: The Door/Handshake model is scientifically strongest as a thresholded network-dynamics framework for studying how relationships form and how states, messages or behaviors propagate once a coupling exists. Each node carries a typed psychological/behavioral state, Gates encode transition compatibility, Doors execute discrete state changes, and Handshakes create or strengthen graph edges. Subsequent propagation can be modeled with signed contagion, threshold dynamics, coupled oscillators or other domain-appropriate processes. The principal scientific difficulty is causal identification: observed similarity between connected nodes can arise from influence, homophily, shared environment or common external input. A serious application must therefore define measurable features, calibrate thresholds on training data, compare against simpler network baselines, test annotation reliability for Life/Strife labels and use longitudinal or intervention designs when making causal claims. 'Nonlocal' in this model means long-range graph adjacency or communication across geographic distance; it is explicitly distinct from Bell-type quantum nonlocality. The framework is T2 as a network/hybrid toy model and can become T3 in a specific dataset if parameters are estimated and predictive performance is validated out of sample.
research_question: Can a thresholded hybrid-network model of state compatibility, edge formation and signed propagation predict relationship formation or subsequent state/message diffusion better than simpler similarity, exposure and contagion baselines?
maturity: T2 general network/hybrid model; T3 possible only after domain-specific calibration and held-out validation

variables.b_i: body/interoceptive or physiological state when actually measured
variables.m_i: belief/model state represented by declared variables

state_space.space: X_i belongs to a typed feature space or manifold M; categorical and continuous components should not be assigned one Euclidean metric by default.
state_space.boundary: Calling M spiritual space is a project interpretation, not evidence for an independently measured extra physical dimension.

gate.calibration: theta_k,beta,tau_k must be fixed from theory/training data or estimated with regularization; post-hoc threshold tuning is exploratory.
gate.hysteresis_option: Use tau_open>tau_close when persistent relationship/state transitions exhibit entry/exit hysteresis.
gate.meaning: Gate is a probabilistic or deterministic compatibility rule, not an invisible physical barrier.

door.meaning: Door is a state-transition/reset map once specified guard conditions are met.
door.event_observable: Door events can be studied through transition counts, first-passage times, dwell times and transition matrices.

handshake.definition: A handshake is an observed or inferred coupling/edge-formation event, not merely similarity.
handshake.pair_score: H_ij=w_s S_ij+w_a A_ij+w_t T_ij+w_p P_ij-kappa N_ij
handshake.edge_probability: A calibrated alternative is P(e_ij=1|Z_ij)=sigma(beta_0+beta^T Z_ij), where Z_ij contains preregistered pair features.
handshake.identifiability_warning: Different weight vectors can yield similar edge predictions when features are correlated. Report parameter uncertainty and regularization/prior sensitivity.
handshake.baseline: Compare against distance/similarity-only, preferential-attachment, common-neighbor and exposure-only models before claiming a special handshake mechanism.

causal_inference_problem.core_warning: Connected people becoming more similar does not by itself identify interpersonal influence.
better_designs: instrumental or matched designs under explicit assumptions
causal_inference_problem.promotion_rule: Use the word causal only when the identification assumptions/design are written into the record.

phase_coupling_toy_model.meaning: Kuramoto-style dynamics provide a real synchronization comparator after a meaningful phase variable is defined.
phase_coupling_toy_model.nulls: Compare measured synchrony against phase-randomized/surrogate and common-input models.
phase_coupling_toy_model.boundary: Synchronization does not imply shared quantum state, telepathy or faster-than-light influence.

nonlocal_relation.definition: Nonlocal means non-geometric or long-range adjacency in the chosen graph: an edge may connect geographically distant nodes through communication, common institutions, shared history, memory or symbolic relation.
nonlocal_relation.graph_distance: Use shortest-path, weighted resistance, communicability or another declared network distance separately from physical distance.
nonlocal_relation.quantum_boundary: Graph nonlocality is not Bell nonlocality. No quantum formalism should be imported unless an actual quantum system and quantum measurements are under study.

seed_states.life: L_i(t)>=0 is a project-defined constructive/nourishing/cultivating content or capacity variable only after an observable coding rule is specified.
seed_states.strife: S_i(t)>=0 is a project-defined conflict/fragmentation variable only after an observable coding rule is specified.
seed_states.neutral: Nodes/messages can contain both or neither; labels should apply to states/content/edges rather than essentialize persons.
seed_states.annotation_contract: Use a written coding rubric, multiple annotators where feasible, and report inter-rater reliability before treating Life/Strife as data.

equations: dL_i/dt=alpha_L L_i(1-L_i/K_L)-mu_L L_i+sum_j W^L_ij f_L(L_j)-gamma_LS L_i S_i
dS_i/dt=alpha_S S_i(1-S_i/K_S)-mu_S S_i+sum_j W^S_ij f_S(S_j)-gamma_SL L_i S_i
competing_propagation.parameter_rule: Growth/decay/coupling terms need domain-specific units and estimation; the equations are not universal moral dynamics.
competing_propagation.stability_question: Analyze fixed points/Jacobian or simulate stochastic variants before describing a state as an attractor.

threshold_contagion.equation: node i adopts state q when [sum_j w_ij 1(q_j=q)]/[sum_j w_ij] >= theta_i
threshold_contagion.serious_test: Fit competing contagion models to the same temporal cascade data and compare out-of-sample event likelihood and cascade-size/time distributions.

stochastic_extension.hazard: lambda_i^q(t)=lambda_0^q exp(beta_q^T X_i(t)+sum_j alpha_q w_ij 1[q_j(t)=q]) as an example event-hazard model
stochastic_extension.value: A hazard/survival formulation can incorporate censoring, varying exposure and event timing more realistically than a deterministic threshold.
stochastic_extension.boundary: This is a modern archive extension, not a recovered Tim equation.

long_range_seed_jump.concept: A state/message can appear far from the current geometric wavefront when a long-range network edge transmits it into a distant cluster.
long_range_seed_jump.test: Compare observed jump distances/times with degree-preserving or spatially constrained network null models.
long_range_seed_jump.boundary: A transmitting relation/channel must exist; unexplained simultaneity is not enough to infer one.

door_seed_operator.research_use: Estimate outcomes from observable affect, trust, conflict, message framing and prior exposure; use held-out calibration rather than mystical frequency labels.

signed_network_version.meaning: Positive/negative edges may encode support/cooperation versus antagonism/inhibition only under a declared coding scheme.
signed_network_version.warning: Positive/negative graph signs are mathematical labels; moral interpretation is additional project semantics.

model_comparison_contract.success: The richer Door/Handshake model adds value only when it improves prediction, identifies interventions or compresses multiple recurrent transition phenomena with stable parameters.

falsification_and_failure_conditions: Handshake variables do not predict edge formation beyond simpler homophily/exposure/network-topology baselines.
Apparent contagion disappears when shared exposure, selection and temporal confounding are modeled.
Life/Strife coding has poor reliability or shifts materially with annotator/context.
Threshold/hazard parameters fail to generalize across held-out periods or networks where generalization is claimed.
Adding Door/Gate structure increases complexity without improving transition/cascade prediction or intervention usefulness.
research_program: Choose one empirical network and one clearly observable transition.
Freeze the state/edge coding rubric and temporal resolution.
Separate selection from influence using longitudinal/intervention structure where possible.
Test propagation model out of sample.
Use topology/persistent-homology analyses only after the event model is validated.
Keep quantum-entanglement language in the comparator layer unless studying a genuine quantum experiment.
